title: ID0399214-DC/Si-D/GB-[Multiple] UK chargers disconnected on SCB
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Multiple UK chargers are offline on SCB.
Root cause:
2 out of 6 chargers are offline because of router issue, need site visit to rectify the fault. 4 out of 6 chargers are offline on SCB for more than 1 month, because either they are powered off or not commissioned.
Solution: Onsite visit
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: NO
Warranty Status: NA
